literal: Than the time she gave birth, greatly will rejoice, her own son, 'a noble person' as heard, the mother.
translation: A mother rejoices far more when she hears her son praised as a noble, virtuous man than she did on the day she gave birth to him.
modern: தன் மகனை அறிவு ஒழுக்கங்களில் சிறந்த சான்றோன் என்று பிறர் சொல்லக் கேட்ட தாய், அவனைப் பெற்றெடுத்த போது அடைந்த மகிழ்ச்சியை விடப் பெரும் மகிழ்ச்சி அடைவாள்.
explanation: This couplet beautifully captures the depth of maternal love and pride. While giving birth brings immense joy to a mother, hearing society praise her child as a 'சான்றோன்' (a person of complete noble character and wisdom) brings an even greater, unparalleled happiness. The word 'சான்றோன்' represents a person who is fully accomplished in virtues, showing that a mother's ultimate fulfillment lies in her child's moral and intellectual growth rather than just physical birth.
